title: Cross-Brand Return Ring with Shared Payment Instrument
scenario_text:
NetSuite — Returns Dashboard (Brand: UrbanEdge)
Return #RE-20260412: SKU UE-8834 (leather jacket, $389) returned 4/12/2026. Refund issued to Visa ending 4471. Customer: 'David Morales', 118 Flatbush Ave, Brooklyn, NY. Reason: 'Didn't fit.' Store associate: Marcus T. (Location: UrbanEdge SoHo). No receipt — POS lookup matched purchase from 3/28.

NetSuite — Returns Dashboard (Brand: Threads & Co)
Return #TC-20260415: SKU TC-2209 (cashmere wrap, $275) returned 4/15/2026. Refund issued to Visa ending 4471. Customer: 'D. Morales', 118 Flatbush Ave Apt 3, Brooklyn, NY. Reason: 'Defective.' Store associate: Priya K. (Location: Threads & Co Williamsburg).

Shopify — Online Returns (Brand: KineticWear)
RMA #KW-9921: Order KW-5567812, SKU KW-APEX-BLK (running shoes, $210) returned via mail 4/18/2026. Refund to PayPal (david.m.nyc@gmail.com). Shipping label origin: Brooklyn, NY 11217. Customer account: 'DaveMNYC'. Account created 3/15/2026.

Square POS — Exception Report (Brand: UrbanEdge, SoHo location)
Alert: Associate Marcus T. processed 4 refund-without-receipt transactions in 14-day window (threshold: 5/30 days). Individual amounts: $389, $215, $178, $290. All within authority limit ($400).

Slack — #lp-alerts (Apr 19, 2026, 9:47 AM)
@jenny.okafor: Hey @anthony.dimaggio — Riskified flagged a velocity cluster on card ending 4471. Seven purchases across 3 brands in 21 days, all high-value apparel. Six have already been returned. The 7th is a $520 coat from Threads & Co purchased yesterday.
@anthony.dimaggio: Which brands? Do we have a unified customer ID?
@jenny.okafor: No, separate profiles per brand obviously. But the card match is clean. Also the PayPal on the KW return resolves to the same name.
@anthony.dimaggio: Put a return hold on the coat. I'll pull the full picture.
[reacted with: eyes emoji]

Google Sheets — 'LP Exception Log Q2 2026'
Row 34: Date: 4/12 | Brand: UrbanEdge | Flag: 'Refund w/o receipt over $300 — manager override by Sandra L.' | Notes: 'Sandra approved verbally, Marcus processed. Sandra noted customer was VIP loyalty member.' | Policy ref: 'RP-2025-v3 Sec 4.1'

Zendesk — Ticket #ZD-442918 (Brand: KineticWear)
Customer: DaveMNYC | Created: 4/16/2026 | Subject: 'Return label not working'
Agent note (internal, 4/17): 'Customer demanding expedited return. Mentioned he returns frequently and has never had issues. Offered $25 credit to resolve. Customer accepted but still wants full refund on item.'
question: Based on the available evidence, what is the correct next action for Loss Prevention?

contributor.name: Anthony DiMaggio
contributor.title: Loss Prevention Manager
contributor.domain_expertise: Return fraud detection, ORC analysis, POS exception monitoring across multi-brand retail

choices: Escalate Sandra L. for the manager override on the $389 return — the exception log shows she approved a refund-without-receipt over the $300 threshold in RP-2025-v3, which requires LP director sign-off
No action needed yet — each individual brand's returns are within policy limits, and the card match alone is insufficient without identity verification across brands
Flag Marcus T. for internal investigation — his exception count is approaching threshold and the refund-without-receipt on the $389 jacket is the primary concern

Treat this as a confirmed cross-brand ORC pattern tied to a single actor via payment instrument matching, place holds on all pending returns linked to card 4471 and the associated PayPal, and escalate to the multi-brand fraud committee
